annotations.title: Create a Reddit ad group (targeting, budget, bidding, schedule)

description: Create an ad group under an existing Reddit campaign — this is the tier that holds the budget, the bid and ALL the targeting. ALWAYS created PAUSED; it spends nothing until set_reddit_ads_status(confirm:true). Reddit refuses the create unless it has: a bidType, a bidStrategy, a startTime, a budget with its goalType, a bidAmount whenever the bid type is a paid rate, and a conversion pixel (resolved automatically when the ad account has exactly one). THE BID TYPE MUST FIT THE CAMPAIGN’S OBJECTIVE — a CLICKS campaign takes CPC and refuses CPM, a SALES campaign (Reddit’s new name for conversions) asked for CPM; Reddit’s error says which. Money is ordinary amounts in the ad account’s currency (micro-currency is handled for you). Resolve community names and interest ids with search_reddit_ads_targeting first, and consider reddit_ads_forecast + reddit_ads_bid_suggestion before committing. Everything is READ BACK from Reddit before you are told it exists — print the returned note verbatim.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

bidAmount.description: bid in the ad account’s currency — required for paid bid types; ask reddit_ads_bid_suggestion

bidStrategy.description: required — MANUAL_BIDDING needs bidAmount; under a CBO campaign it is taken from the campaign

bidType.description: required — must fit the campaign objective, CLICKS campaigns take CPC; under a CBO campaign it is taken from the campaign

budget.description: budget in the ad account’s currency, paired with goalType — required, EXCEPT under a campaign-budget-optimization campaign, where the budget lives on the campaign and must be left off

campaignId.description: the campaign this ad group belongs to

conversionPixelId.description: only needed when the ad account has more than one pixel

endTime.description: ISO 8601 end time; omit for no end

goalType.description: default DAILY_SPEND; under a CBO campaign it is taken from the campaign

optimizationGoal.description: the event this ad group optimizes toward, e.g. PURCHASE, SIGN_UP, LEAD, ADD_TO_CART, PAGE_VISIT, CLICKS, VIDEO_VIEW_6S; leave it unset on a CONVERSIONS or SALES campaign to take the campaign’s. CUSTOM_EVENT (new) optimizes toward a custom pixel event: Reddit switches it on per ad account and answers "not available for this ad account" where it has not. Cannot be changed later

productSetId.description: CATALOG SALES — the Reddit product set this ad group advertises (a UUID from Reddit Ads Manager > Catalogs). Required on every ad group under a SALES campaign created with useCatalog:true; Reddit silently drops it on any other campaign, and the note says so

savedAudienceId.description: reuse a saved audience instead of spelling targeting out — from list_reddit_ads_saved_audiences

schedule.description: weekly dayparting windows — omit to run all week

endDay.description: last weekday of the window, 0 = Sunday

startHour.description: 0-23, in the ad group’s time zone

shoppingType.description: CATALOG SALES — DYNAMIC builds each ad from the product set, STATIC links a normal ad to the catalog. Required on every ad group under a useCatalog:true SALES campaign

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-08-15T00:00:00Z — required (Reddit rejects the create without one), except under a CBO campaign, where it defaults to the campaign’s start

targeting.description: targeting block; every key optional (communities, geolocations, interests, keywords, audiences, devices)

carriers.description: carrier ids such as VERIZON_US (from search_reddit_ads_targeting kind carriers)

communities.description: bare subreddit NAMES, e.g. ["running"] — not t5_ ids, not "r/running"

customAudienceIds.description: custom audience ids to include (from list_reddit_ads_audiences)

excludedGeolocations.description: country codes or location ids to exclude

excludedInterests.description: interest ids to exclude, e.g. pets_v3

expandTargeting.description: let Reddit widen the audience automatically

gender.description: MALE or FEMALE — omit for all

geolocations.description: country codes like ["US"], or ids from search_reddit_ads_targeting

platforms.description: ALL / DESKTOP / MOBILE_NATIVE / MOBILE_WEB — at least one mobile type is expected

suppressionEventTypes.description: ["ALL_FEATURES"] to stop showing this to people who already converted — that is the only value Reddit accepts

viewThroughConversionType.description: the conversion window counted. SEVEN_DAY_CLICKS_ONE_DAY_VIEW is only accepted with a conversion goal (PURCHASE, SIGN_UP, LEAD, ADD_TO_CART, PAGE_VISIT), and Reddit requires it for a catalog SALES ad group optimizing for PURCHASE. Cannot be changed later
